correctness.rationale: Original capacity-(1,1) existence is characterized by either a dominant feasible couple option or an S1-stable singles bijection not blocked by a listed couple option. Structural and independent direct exhaustive programs each examine all 11,520 profiles; both count 640 without stable matches and the direct program tests every proposed match under both one-seat expansions, finding each of the 640 repairable at both sites. Explicit witness gives true nonexistence. The finite sample space is exhaustively bounded, not sampled.
